run_obb_eval_csv: run the EFM eval pipeline comparing prediction and ground truth OBB CSV files with configurable IoU threshold
run_obb_eval_dataset: run dataset-level OBB evaluation on all sequences in an input folder with precision recall metrics
run_check_sem_id_conflict: run semantic ID conflict detection between prediction and ground truth semantic ID to name mappings
run_evaluate_obb_csv: run OBB CSV evaluation computing precision, recall, and mAP metrics for 3D oriented bounding boxes
run_obb_eval_main: run the EFM eval CLI with argparse to evaluate OBB predictions against ground truth CSV files
